channel.title: Korea Plainly: places to visit
channel.description: Places worth visiting across Korea, for first-time visitors.

item.title: Sokcho Tourist & Fishery Market: A Taste of the Coast
item.description: Sokcho Tourist & Fishery Market is a lively traditional market where you can browse local goods and sample the city’s coastal food culture.

item.title: Naksansa Temple: A Seaside Sanctuary Above the East Sea
item.description: Naksansa is a historic Buddhist temple overlooking the East Sea, worth visiting for its coastal views, quiet courtyards and cliffside shrines.

item.title: Biseondae Peak: Seoraksan’s Scenic Rock Terrace
item.description: Biseondae is a striking rock terrace beside a mountain stream, reached by a rewarding walk into Seoraksan National Park.

item.title: Seoraksan National Park: Sokcho’s mountain gateway
item.description: Seoraksan National Park’s Seorak-dong district is a scenic mountain gateway, with temple grounds, hiking trails and access to dramatic peaks.

item.title: Chungchosoo Mulhoe: Sokcho’s Chilled Seafood Specialty
item.description: A Sokcho seafood restaurant best known for mulhoe, a refreshing chilled raw-fish soup that suits a warm day by the coast.

item.title: Seaside Garden: A coastal café in Goseong
item.description: Seaside Garden is a sea-view café on the Goseong coast, a relaxed stop for a drink and a break from sightseeing.

item.description: This is a convenient place to eat inside Incheon Airport Terminal 2, especially when you want a meal without leaving the terminal.

item.title: Joyang Textile: A Factory Turned Café
item.description: Joyang Textile is a former factory turned café and exhibition space, worth visiting for its industrial character and eclectic interiors.

item.title: Hyundai Premium Outlets Songdo: Fashion, food and more
item.description: Hyundai Premium Outlets Songdo is a large outlet mall where you can browse fashion, accessories, cafés and places to eat in one stop.
